title: Diecai Mountain, Guilin, China: Best Li River Viewpoint
excerpt: A 10-minute climb in central Guilin puts you above the whole city and the Li River at once — Diecai Mountain is the easy overlook locals forget.

title: Liuzhou Luosifen — a Heavy-Industry City That Found Its Fame in a Bowl of Noodles
excerpt: There aren't many cities where the thing worth traveling for is a smell. Liuzhou, a heavy-industry city in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, became famous for luosifen — a bowl of noodles that turned a factory town into a food destination.

title: Elephant Trunk Hill — Guilin's Symbol, With None of the Queue
excerpt: Every city has one landmark the locals quietly stop noticing, and Guilin's is Elephant Trunk Hill. The mountain in the middle of town really does look like an elephant putting its trunk down to drink from the river — and yet you can walk up, take the classic photo, and be out again without fighting a crowd.

title: Yangshuo West Street — the Small-Town Street That Went Global
excerpt: Yangshuo's West Street is a small-town pedestrian street that accidentally became a global one — three decades of backpackers turned an old county lane into a lively night strip of bars, stalls, and beer fish. Go at night, eat the fish, step off the street when you need quiet.
